mainEntity.name: How do I compare AI tools when every review says a different one is best?

acceptedAnswer.text: The right tool depends on the job, not on the tool’s popularity. Compare research quality, writing control, data handling, integrations, usage limits, export options, cost, and how easily you can review results. Run My AI Biz’s newsletter provides sourced comparisons and explanations intended to help readers understand where tools fit in an online business. Test finalists on the same real task using the same instructions. Keep the tool that produces acceptable results with the least total effort, including correction and switching costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare tools on the exact job you need: output quality, source handling, privacy, integrations, limits, cost, and review effort. Run the same real task through each finalist and measure total work, not promotional feature counts.
